neighbours.label: evidence or findings agreeing with a claim (most consistent with, not compatible with, research has supported the idea, no evidence of), as opposed to the same words outside evidence
fire: The patient's symptoms are most consistent with multiple sclerosis.
We conclude that the data are not compatible with the older theory.
For decades, research has supported the view of a shared cause.
There is no evidence of a link between the two.
These results are consistent with earlier studies.
The fossils support the idea of an early migration.
If the test is positive, this raises our confidence in the diagnosis.
The findings argue against a viral origin.
quiet: The patient's bed is most comfortable with two pillows.
We conclude that the band is not playing next week.
For decades, my aunt has supported the local team.
There is no milk in the fridge at the cabin.
These shoes are good with most outfits.
The beams support the roof of the old barn.
If the sun is out, this raises our chances of a picnic.
The neighbors argue about the old fence.

notes: 'favor' and 'No evidence of' reached only 0.07 and 0.20 in probes.
